name: Node Add Copy
description: Create a new node preloaded with another node's values.
project_description:
Use Quick Node Clone instead. It does the same and more.

Changing to Unsupported. 

 Creates a form of the same node type with info preloaded with another node values

 Why? 
 Several great modules out there provide the ability to clone nodes. However, the node is created immediately and then you can edit it.

This module allows copying the values from a 'Node add' form, so you can check and edit the info before the node is created.
